import numpy as np
# Linear baseline subtraction
mask_base_left = (x >= 1100 - 10) & (x <= 1100 + 10)
mask_base_right = (x >= 1800 - 10) & (x <= 1800 + 10)
y_base_1 = np.mean(y1[mask_base_left])
y_base_2 = np.mean(y1[mask_base_right])
x_base_1 = np.mean(x[mask_base_left])
x_base_2 = np.mean(x[mask_base_right])
if x_base_2 > x_base_1:
    slope = (y_base_2 - y_base_1) / (x_base_2 - x_base_1)
    intercept = y_base_1 - slope * x_base_1
    baseline = slope * x + intercept
else:
    baseline = np.full_like(x, y_base_1)
y1 = y1 - baseline
# Normalize by G-band max (1550-1620 cm-1)
mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
g_max = np.max(y1[mask_g])
if g_max != 0:
    y1 = y1 / g_max
